description: List UK parliamentary written questions still waiting for a government answer, most recently tabled first, with the department due to answer and the date the answer is due. Useful for public affairs teams tracking what departments have been asked. Source: UK Parliament Written Questions API (Commons and Lords). Shows the queue as published; it does not judge whether a department is late. (cost: 1 credit)

take.description: int, optional, number of questions 1-100, default 20

name: unanswered_written_questions
